destination.name: Mamanuca Islands
destination.tagline: Resort and day-trip islands off Denarau with lagoon snorkelling and reef surf
destination.description: The Mamanucas are a group of resort and day-trip islands off Denarau. South Sea Island is a 30-minute day trip from Denarau, and Beachcomber Island is reached by catamaran. Mana Island has three beach areas and lagoon snorkelling, while Treasure Island and Bounty Island are marine-reserve islands. Monuriki, an uninhabited island, is where the film Cast Away was shot, and Cloudbreak off Tavarua is a well-known reef surf break.
whyVisit: Escape to an island for the day

goodToKnow.title: Day trips leave Denarau
goodToKnow.detail: Beachcomber Island is reached by catamaran from Denarau, and South Sea Island is a 30-minute trip.

goodToKnow.title: Cloudbreak is for experts
goodToKnow.detail: Cloudbreak is a reef wave off Tavarua, reached by boat, so paddle out only if you are an experienced surfer.

goodToKnow.title: Monuriki needs a boat trip
goodToKnow.detail: Monuriki is uninhabited and off the beaten track, so reach it on a trip arranged with an operator.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Come in {months} for island days of snorkelling and beach time. Cyclones can occur Nov to Apr.

mamanuca-islands-1.bio: Small uninhabited island where Cast Away was filmed, with white sand beaches and a pine forest, reached by boat.

mamanuca-islands-2.bio: Resort island with three beach areas, lagoon snorkelling and water sports, and the setting of the Survivor TV series.

mamanuca-islands-3.bio: Small island resort known as the party island, with snorkelling, a glass-bottom boat and a nightly Bula Dance.

mamanuca-islands-4.bio: A marine-reserve island resort off Nadi with a pool, tennis courts, snorkelling and a turtle restoration programme.

mamanuca-islands-5.bio: A tiny island a short catamaran ride from Port Denarau with a saltwater pool, free snorkel gear and a coral viewer submarine.

mamanuca-islands-6.bio: A private island 30 minutes from Denarau with white sandy beaches, a small resort and snorkelling in a marine reserve.

mamanuca-islands-7.bio: A reef wave off Tavarua, one of Fiji's best-known surf breaks, reached by boat from nearby island resorts.
